Coordinate with the team to design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable C# code with Visual Studio or other IDEs
Work alongside developers to write and optimize complex SQL statements for DB validations
Collaborate on Tableau Dashboard development and validation to help ensure data correctness
Contribute to the development of GraphQL APIs and help design GraphQL schemas
Support CI/CD pipeline ceremonies using Jenkins or GitLab
Coordinate with team members to scope and estimate test automation effort for user stories and their acceptance criteria
Communicate defects and verify fixes together with the team within each increment
Participate in all Agile ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, story grooming, reviews, and retrospectives)
Work with Business Customers and Technology support through partnering, negotiation, and clear communication
Share updates and present ideas and strategies in both technical and user-friendly language to a variety of audiences
Help troubleshoot, perform root-cause analysis, and coordinate solution development and implementation within specific technology areas
cond_0225.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
10–12 Years of experience with various automation tools and technologies
Experience developing and enhancing automation frameworks
Strong programming experience in Core Java and object-oriented concepts
Strong coding experience with Python for automation scripts
Strong experience with web services automation using Rest Assured or Karate
Experience with Java and Selenium WebDriver automation frameworks
Experience with BDD tools such as JBehave or Cucumber
Must have experience with CI/CD pipeline using Jenkins or GitLab
3+ Years of experience with mobile automation using Appium or SeeTest for Android and iOS
Experience with SQL Server for performance tuning and query optimization, including inserting data via stored procedures
Experience with source code revision control systems like GIT
Strong knowledge of Page Object Model
Ability to analyze and resolve problems of moderate to high complexity
Strong written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills and analytical/creative problem-solving skills
Preferred Requirements:
Expertise working with JSON objects
Experience handling Jira APIs
Experience designing GraphQL schemas and contributing to GraphQL API development
Expertise with stubbing and mocking of test data
Experience with build tools like Maven or Gradle
Good understanding of web development technologies — HTML, JavaScript, CSS
Ability to develop and present ideas effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences
Ability to manage priorities and set expectations in a team-based, customer service-oriented environment
